blocks.output_text_grid: [Claim 1] A medical endoscope processor comprising: a power supply circuit; an endoscope connection interface; a discharge resistor arranged between the power supply circuit and the endoscope connection interface; a power conduction circuit arranged between the discharge resistor and the endoscope connection interface; an endoscope connection detection unit that detects when an endoscope is connected to the endoscope connection interface; and a control unit connected to the detection unit and controlling the power supply circuit, wherein: the control unit, upon detecting by the detection unit that the endoscope has transitioned from an disconnected state to a connected state, establishes conduction in the power conduction circuit to cause electrical conduction between the endoscope and the discharge resistor, thereby discharging any accumulated charge in the endoscope through the discharge resistor in the endoscope processor; and when power is supplied to the endoscope via the power supply circuit, the power conduction circuit establishes non-conduction between the endoscope and the discharge resistor.
